The parts as I read them:

| Part | Role | Rotation applied |
|---|---|---|
| kit-p04 | Base | none |
| kit-p05 | Lower arm | −35° |
| kit-p08 | Elbow knuckle (three holes) | −125° |
| kit-p01 | Upper arm | −70° |
| kit-p07 | Head bracket | −55° |
| kit-p03 | Shade and socket housing, with pivot tab | −160° |
| kit-p02 | Bulb (screw base and globe) | −25° |
| kit-p06 | Not identified; placement is a guess | 160° |

**How I set the angles:** each circle in the kit carries a rotation value in its arc command (0 on the base, 35 on p05, and so on). I undid that value on each part. As a check, this puts the bulb axis within about 3° of the shade axis.

**Chain of connections:**
1. The bottom hole of p05 sits on the base pivot hole.
2. The top hole of p05 meets p08's 4.11 hole.
3. p08's 2.5 hole meets the lower end of p01.
4. The upper end of p01 meets p07's 2.5 hole.
5. p07's lower 3.58 hole meets the shade's tab hole.

I rejected the other arrangements because they would push the arm through the shade or put the head below the desk.

**Uncertain points:**
- **Bulb seat:** p03 has no marked socket point. I seated the bulb's contact at the centre of the socket housing, on the shade axis. With that seat the globe starts right at the throat of the cone.
- **p06:** I could not tell what this L-shaped part is or where it attaches, so its position and angle may well fail grading. I stood it on the flat recess in the top of the base, next to the arm pivot.
